goodAirDaysNote: No published state-level share of 'Good' AQI days for 2024 was found. EPA AirData publishes it by county and CBSA only. plainairdata.com and aer-terra.com show state AQI averages derived from EPA data, but they are unofficial aggregations and could not be opened. Left empty (UNKNOWN).

national.note: AHR 2025: up 13% from 7.8 (2019-2021). Range is 4.1 (WY) to 11.7 (CA). Confirmed by several snippets, including AHR's own finding text and weather.com.

conflicts: Visual Capitalist 'cp/' maps and snippets quoting 'Georgia 8.9 worst, Idaho 8.7, Rhode Island 3.6, Maine 5.0, Vermont 5.0, Alaska 3.6' appear to be IQAir monitor data (a different year and method). They contradict AHR 2025, where California (11.7) is worst and Wyoming (4.1) is best. Excluded.
A search snippet claimed AHR says Alabama fell 'from 15.6 to 8.1' since 2003. That is an older AHR edition, not 2022-2024. Excluded.
An oklahoma-ahr23 snippet gave 6.3 against a U.S. value of 8.6. That U.S. value matches no known AHR vintage (the 2023 report used 7.8 or similar). This is an unreliable snippet merge. Excluded.
An allstatesummaries-ahr23 snippet quoted the U.S. value going 7.0 to 5.7, and Arizona 8.6 to 11.1. These numbers are internally inconsistent (probably merged rows). Excluded.
The requested cross-check of 10 states against two sources was not possible. Only CA and WY have two consistent sources (AHR finding text and weather.com).
